control.name: CONTROL — stop refusing a custody file owned by another Windows user (a credential could be read from a file this user does not own)

mutations.name: accept a foreign write-capable ACE (any principal that can rewrite the token file passes owner-only custody)
accept a foreign read-capable ACE (a principal other than the owner can read the credential file, which unix 0600 excludes)
drop FILE_READ_DATA from the read-capable mask (a data-read grant decodes as no read)
drop GENERIC_READ from the read-capable mask (a generic read grant decodes as no read)
stop naming an inherited grant's origin in the refusal (the operator is not told to protect the DACL)
treat an uninterpretable DACL entry as clean instead of refusing (write scope is guessed, not established)
mutations.old:
case rosterACEUnsupported:
			return fmt.Errorf("custody file %s has a Windows DACL entry (#%d) this tool cannot "+
				"interpret — refusing rather than guessing its write scope", path, i)

mutations.name: pass an undeterminable owner instead of refusing (a could-not-check ownership is rounded up to clean)
